# blobkit

> Unified blob storage for Rust: one Store trait with Memory, Local, and S3
> backends, replacing per-service S3 client construction duplicated across
> estate services.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): store trait semantics, backend selection, quick start.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-BK-001..202 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [PERF-SLO.md](PERF-SLO.md): performance SLOs and benchmark results.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): performance claims inventory.
- [COVERAGE-NOTES.md](COVERAGE-NOTES.md): coverage notes and exclusions.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
